content:
UGC Jobs for Beginners (2026): Where to Find Them and What They Pay

Most UGC jobs for beginners are short briefs: film a 15 to 30 second video of a product, deliver it in a few days, get paid per video. This guide covers where those jobs are posted, what they pay, how to tell a real job from a scam, and how to win your first few.

Table of Contents

1. What beginner UGC jobs pay
2. Where to find UGC jobs
3. How to win your first jobs
4. Red flags and scams
5. FAQ

1. What Beginner UGC Jobs Pay

We looked at the 81 paid UGC gigs for US creators that Newcollab listed in September and October 2026:

Result
Median posted pay$150
Middle half of offers$35 to $600
Pay structuresPer video; monthly retainer for a set number of videos; base fee plus a bonus per 1,000 views
Most active hirersConsumer apps and DTC product brands

Compare offers on pay per finished video, and check whether usage rights are included. More in the UGC rates guide.

2. Where to Find UGC Jobs

SourceGood forWatch out for
UGC platforms (Billo, JoinBrands, Insense, Trend and others)Steady briefs, payment handled for youCountry rules, fixed prices on some platforms
Freelance job boards (Upwork and similar)Higher-paying, longer projectsCompetition, platform fees
Brand creator programsRepeat work with one brandApplications open and close
Direct pitchingYour own prices, long-term clientsTakes consistent outreach
Newcollab gigs feedPaid UGC gigs from several sources in one feed, filterable by nicheFull feed is on the Pro plan

We compare the main UGC platforms side by side, including who can join and how they pay, in the best UGC platforms for creators.

3. How to Win Your First Jobs

  1. Have a portfolio link ready before you apply. Brands open it first. See UGC portfolio examples.
  2. Answer the brief, not your bio: one line on the angle you would film and which hook you would open with.
  3. Apply within a day of a job being posted. Early applications get read.
  4. Offer two or three hook variations. It costs ten minutes and sets you apart.
  5. Deliver early, then ask how the video performed. Results win the next job.

Prefer to go direct? Pitch brands that pay for UGC and smaller brands that work with creators with no followers.

Make Every Application Stronger

A free UGC portfolio with samples and rates gets more replies than a Drive folder.

Build My Free UGC Portfolio

4. Red Flags and Scams

  • You are asked to pay a fee to get the job or to "unlock" payment.
  • The brand asks for bank logins, codes sent to your phone, or to cash a check and send money back.
  • You must buy the product yourself with no written refund or reimbursement.
  • The conversation moves to a messaging app before there is any written brief or contract.
  • The pay is far above the market for a single short video, with urgency to start today.

Before you start, get the deliverables, usage and payment terms in writing. Our UGC contract checklist covers what to include.

Get Ready Before You Apply

Publish your samples and rates on one page brands can open.

Publish My Free UGC Portfolio

Free. No account needed. No follower minimum.

FAQ

Where can beginners find UGC jobs?

UGC platforms that accept new creators (several state no follower minimum), freelance job boards, brand creator programs, and direct pitching to small and mid-size brands. Newcollab also collects paid UGC gigs from several sources into one feed.

How much do beginner UGC jobs pay?

Across 81 paid US UGC gigs listed on Newcollab in September and October 2026, the median posted pay was $150, with the middle half between $35 and $600. Many beginner jobs pay per video; some pay a monthly fee or a base plus a view bonus.

Are UGC jobs legit?

Most are, but scams exist. Never pay to get a job, never share bank logins, and be wary of jobs that ask you to buy the product with no clear refund, or that move you to a messaging app before any contract.

Do UGC jobs require posting on my account?

Not always. Many UGC jobs are content-only: you upload the video and the brand posts it. Jobs that require posting on your own account usually pay more.
